newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner sees no major acquisitions - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner sees no major acquisitions - analyst.

text.p: Time Warner Inc Chief Financial Officer Richard Bressler said the company doesn't expect to make any more significant acquisitions in the foreseeable future, according to Morgan Stanley Dean Witter analyst Rich Bilotti.

Bressler made his comments during a luncheon hosted by Morgan Stanley for Bressler and a small group of investors, Bilotti wrote in the July 9 issue of Morgan Stanley's U.S. and Americas Investment Perspectives newsletter.
Bressler said the company will use discretionary cash flow this year primarily to reduce debt, according to Bilotti.
By late 1998, the company will use free cash flow to accelerate internal growth and buy back stock, he said.
Bressler said one of the company's key goals is for return on investment to exceed 15 percent.
